licenses.text:
Public domain.

Seneca died in 65. Aubrey Stewart (1844-1918) translated them, first published in 1887 and 1889 by
George Bell and Sons, London, United Kingdom; the notes are by J. E. B. Mayor (1825-1910).

United States: published before 1931. United Kingdom (country of origin): every author and
translator died more than 70 years ago.

Standard Ebooks dedicates its own contributions (markup, corrections) to the public domain under
CC0 1.0 (the repository's LICENSE.md).

Sources: en.wikisource.org/wiki/Author:Aubrey_Stewart; en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Eyton_Bickersteth_Mayor.
